summary: Verified all fixes for the GET /api/prep/{meetingId}/context 500 error. All 31 backend tests passed (expanded from 22 to 31). Frontend UI confirmed prep page loads without error for both new and existing meetings with previous analyses. The root cause (edited_summary column missing in production analyses table) is fixed via ALTER TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guards in init_db.py.
critical_code_review_comments: All 4 fixes confirmed: (1) ALTER TABLE analyses ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS edited_summary TEXT at init_db.py line 526, (2) ALTER TABLE analyses ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_edited_at TEXT at init_db.py line 527, (3) All 4 sub-queries in prep.py get_prep_context wrapped in try/except with logger.warning, (4) MeetingPrep.js line 287 uses Promise.allSettled
prep.py analyses SELECT query at line 219 includes 'edited_summary' column — the column that was missing in production
No regressions detected — existing meeting 91357f81 with attendees + previous analyses loads cleanly (Context Sources 1/1, 5 question sections)

success_rate.frontend: 100% — existing meeting with previous analyses loads without error toast; prep sections render correctly

seed_data_creation: Test meetings created and deleted during pytest fixtures: TEST_PrepContextBugFix_* (with attendees) and TEST_NoAttendees_* (no attendees)
context_for_next_testing_agent: The edited_summary/last_edited_at column bug is fully resolved. Both ALTER TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guards confirmed in init_db.py (lines 526-527). All 4 try/except blocks confirmed in prep.py get_prep_context (previous_meetings line 198-237, supervision_uploads lines 241-266, standards_documents lines 269-285, focus_topics lines 289-295). MeetingPrep.js Promise.allSettled confirmed at line 287. Existing meeting 91357f81-8092-4791-b7d5-e9b3ef646620 'Supervision with Jane Smith' has attendees + previous analyses and loads correctly. Test file updated: /app/backend/tests/test_prep_context_bug_fix.py (now 31 tests covering all 4 new requirements).
rca_of_issue: Root cause: The 'edited_summary' and 'last_edited_at' columns were added to the analyses CREATE TABLE DDL but had no ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS guard. In production, the table was already created without these columns, so the SELECT query 'SELECT summary, edited_summary, actions FROM analyses WHERE id=$1' failed with column-does-not-exist error → 500. Fix: Added ALTER TABLE guards at init_db.py lines 526-527. Defense-in-depth: Wrapped all 4 sub-queries in try/except so any future column missing would degrade gracefully. Frontend: Promise.allSettled so context failure doesn't block the entire prep page.
